name: Daemonic Empowerment
summary: Emperor's Children and Legions of Excess units within 6" of each other are Empowered: their weapons gain Sustained Hits 1, or crit on unmodified 5+ if they already had it. Take up to 500/1000/1500 pts of Legions of Excess, never Warlord.

name: Pledges to the Dark Prince
summary: Each battle round your Warlord pledges a count of enemy units to destroy; meet it for that many Pact points, else it takes D3 mortal wounds. Cumulative: 1+ re-roll Hit 1s, 3+ Wound 1s, 5+ melee Lethal and Sustained Hits 1, 7+ crit on 5+.

name: Master of the Pageant
summary: Once per battle round, reduce the CP cost of the Sinuous Breach or Prideful Superiority Stratagem by 1 when used on a Fulgrim unit.

name: Sensational Performance
summary: An Emperor's Children unit that made a Charge move can, when it fights, give its melee weapons +1 Strength and AP for the phase if it targets neither a unit it started the turn in Engagement Range of nor one already attacked this phase.

name: Quicksilver Grace
summary: Friendly Emperor's Children units can re-roll Advance rolls.

name: Exquisite Swordsmanship
summary: An Emperor's Children unit that charged this turn chooses Lethal Hits or Sustained Hits 1 for its melee weapons when it fights.

name: Mechanised Murder
summary: An Emperor's Children Transport model, or one that disembarked this turn, re-rolls a Hit roll of 1 and a Wound roll of 1 on its attacks.

name: Internal Rivalries
summary: Emperor's Children Character units ignore Move, Advance and Charge modifiers. Your Warlord's unit starts as Favoured Champions, replaced by the first Character unit to destroy an enemy each turn; it re-rolls wound rolls.
